# sherpa-chart-legend

A legend for charts. Figma "Chart Legend" (1098:37846).

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | chart |
| Figma | Chart Legend |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-chart-legend/sherpa-chart-legend.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-chart-legend/sherpa-chart-legend.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-chart-legend/sherpa-chart-legend.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-chart-legend/sherpa-chart-legend.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-chart-legend/sherpa-chart-legend.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-chart-legend data-orientation="horizontal"></sherpa-chart-legend>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-chart-legend`:

```json
[
  {
    "label": "Pro",
    "value": 12,
    "colorIndex": 1
  },
  {
    "label": "Team",
    "value": 8,
    "colorIndex": 2
  },
  {
    "label": "Free",
    "value": 3,
    "colorIndex": 3
  }
]
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-aggregate` | `count` `sum` `mean` `min` `max` `distinct` |  |  |
| `data-bands` | text |  |  |
| `data-bucket` | `day` `month` `year` |  |  |
| `data-field` | text |  |  |
| `data-orientation` | `horizontal` `vertical` | `vertical` | vertical \| horizontal |
| `data-over-field` | text |  |  |
| `data-readonly` | boolean |  | a KEY, not a filter: its rows do not toggle |
| `data-segment-field` | text |  | ASKED of its provider, or read off its chart: one row per value. A click narrows its chart alone |
| `data-where` | text |  |  |
